summary: Issue #648: wires Daigotsu Shiraume (oracle-l5r-10317, personality-wave-122: his only text is an entry Honor loss of 1, the engine's EntryHonorLoss) and Without Mercy (oracle-l5r-10405, strategy-wave-111: 'Reaction: After a Battle action performed by your Samurai Personality resolves, if the action did not target an enemy card: Take an additional Battle action'), so the Spider Conquer deck is playable. Engine: ResolvedActionFacts now records what an action targeted (command targets, a duel's challenged Personality, an Attack's target card), the after-action-resolved window checks it (src/L5R.Core/WithoutMercy.cs), and that window hands priority back to the acting player when a Reaction inside it granted an additional Battle action. Both scans were read by eye. Shared because the two card scans (src/L5R.Client/Content/Published) and the regenerated catalogue-art.json belong to the card-art pipeline under the client path; no client code or UI changed. Mendon's standing authority (collaboration.json). Art pack: new private release catalogue-art-issue648-20261004-r1 (4022 images, +2) built incrementally on issue622-r1.
validation: New without-mercy tests 5/5; mutating each rule (ignore enemy targets, ignore Samurai, no priority hand-back) makes a test fail (the player check survives because the performer-owner check also covers it). Full Core suite 2382 PASS / 0 FAIL. Python content tests 139 pass after the art pack update (the catalogue-coverage test failed before it). check_format and lint clean. Art pack: sha256 8478a85a9238c8c89ca4aef5ee9aed78e9de7373dca7a82ead21aa7b6799ce28, 544153542 bytes; ensure_catalogue_art --archive and --verify-only pass. Inventory: wired 1573 -> 1575. NOT verified: no human playtest, no native visual check.
remaining: Mendon to confirm the readings: an action that targets nothing, or only the performer's own cards, did not 'target an enemy card'; a duel targets the challenged Personality. Native visual acceptance of the two card faces.
